description: This Java source file defines the class UnmodifiableExternalMessage, which implements the ExternalMessage interface. It represents an immutable message object used for inter-actor communication within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity services, encapsulating headers, payloads, context, and metadata.

classes.name: UnmodifiableExternalMessage
classes.description: An immutable implementation of ExternalMessage used for message passing between actors, encapsulating headers, payload, context, and metadata.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the unmodifiable map of message headers.

methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage with an added header.

methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage with additional headers.

methods.name: withTopicPath

methods.description: Finds a header by key, case-sensitive.

methods.name: findHeaderIgnoreCase
